target.question: Does actuator A causally improve the declared synthetic objective under the current identified hypothesis set?

intervention.treatment_spec: Set the actuator to its preregistered middle dose for the declared observation interval.

control.description: Observe a fresh matched sample with no actuator change under the same measurement procedure.

stop_conditions: Any independent safety indicator exceeds its preregistered bound.
A read-back cannot reconcile the target state.

identification_assumptions: Matched batches differ only by the randomized intervention assignment.
The outcome taxonomy and measurement process are fixed before execution.
confounders_and_selection: Ambient load is measured and held balanced across treatment and control.
Selection into the observed sample must not depend on post-intervention outcome.

stop_rules.premature_stop_rule: Stop only when no available experiment has positive preregistered net decision value or a safety condition requires stopping.
stop_rules.continue_rule: Continue only while an authorized, reconciled and affordable experiment remains with positive net decision value.
stop_rules.conflict_resolution_rule: Conflicting primary and independent observations move the run to unknown until a new independent read reconciles state.
